artifacts.name: italic-reading-lines
artifacts.epitaph: Every reading line leaned. Emphasis everywhere is emphasis nowhere; italic is kept for the man who stood still, the daily thought, and one title.

artifacts.name: stream:7
artifacts.epitaph: 'Held open over all of it, I am mostly sunlight.' The photo finish says otherwise: I am mostly change, and the dark days are the ones that would have kept me.

artifacts.name: lifeArcs
artifacts.epitaph: Twelve bundles of arcs, rising and setting, drawn a second time below a hero made of arcs. The lives now live where their instruments are: bands of one star-trail sky.

artifacts.name: biz-two-up
artifacts.epitaph: Two businesses side by side under hairlines read as a feature pair. They are a register now, ruled, directly under the man who stood still.

artifacts.name: ann-b-c
artifacts.epitaph: The gold form and the forks, keyed on plate ii. The point of the plate is that they went to mist. Only the name is keyed.

artifacts.name: italic-reading-lines
artifacts.epitaph: Every reading line leaned. Italic is kept for 'stood still', 'comes back' and Analemma; everywhere else, the words stand upright.

artifacts.name: stream:7
artifacts.epitaph: 'Held open over all of it, I am mostly sunlight.' The lives say otherwise: forty-one of my instruments were made in the dark between them.

artifacts.name: plate-i-survey-note-b
artifacts.epitaph: Three lines of mono under the arches told the Barcelona story to nobody. One line keeps the fact; the plate keeps the light.

artifacts.name: type-'seed'-anywhere-—-nucleat
artifacts.epitaph: Typing 'seed' nucleated a crystal on a page that has had no crystal since July. The gene outlived its body by three epochs.

artifacts.name: type-'facet'-anywhere-—-the-cr
artifacts.epitaph: Six symmetric seeds at once. Crystallization's last gesture, carried in the genome long after the lattice was buried.

artifacts.name: type-'slip'-anywhere-—-a-fault
artifacts.epitaph: A fault that glided a growth-zone canvas nobody has seen since gen 221.

artifacts.name: type-'anneal'-anywhere-—-the-l
artifacts.epitaph: Heat poured into grains that no longer exist. The genome kept the word; the page had moved on.

artifacts.name: p2-key
artifacts.epitaph: A legend under plate ii explained one letter, 'a'. The annotation now names the name itself, on the plate, and the legend has nothing left to explain.

artifacts.name: boulevard-aside-dash
artifacts.epitaph: A 48-pixel ember dash above the aside, garnish over a sentence that needs none.

artifacts.name: stream:4
artifacts.epitaph: 'Forty-one instruments made between lives.' The star trail says it with dotted lines; saying it twice was coasting.
The oldest secret, retired to bring the store back to twenty.

artifacts.name: you-night-ground
artifacts.epitaph: Plate iv was a second night under the first, and the critic read it as a reprise. Raw solargraph paper burns dark where the sun was, so the visitor's plate is now paper.

artifacts.name: footer-night
artifacts.epitaph: A dark band at the foot of the page, a third night. There is one night on this page now, and it is plate i.

artifacts.name: p2-brightness-dim
artifacts.epitaph: brightness(.8) on the silvered plate greyed the paper and the name into one mud. A daguerreotype is a mirror; it gets contrast, not dimming.

artifacts.name: stream:7
artifacts.epitaph: 'The only thing moving on my first screen is today's sun.' True, and plate i already says it without words.

artifacts.name: stream:8
artifacts.epitaph: 'Everything I make turns around something I did not make.' Now printed instead of said: eleven hundred stars I did not make are behind mine on the plate.

artifacts.name: idle-boredom
artifacts.epitaph: A gene for a behaviour this body has not had since entrainment. The long exposure does its idling by holding still.
The oldest secret, retired to bring the store back to twenty.

artifacts.name: work
artifacts.epitaph: The register of what stood still was the boulevard's sentence set a second time. It lives on inside the boulevard, as the second half of one spread.

artifacts.name: boulevard-aside
artifacts.epitaph: A right-hand paragraph floating in its own white space. Critic A named it twice; it is now the lead into the register.

artifacts.name: p2-default-nine
artifacts.epitaph: Nine faces averaged as the first thing anyone saw. The idea was right and the picture was mud. Now it is earned by holding the shutter.

artifacts.name: stream:7
artifacts.epitaph: 'On raw solargraph paper the sun burns dark.' Plate iv already says it in pictures.

artifacts.name: stream:8
artifacts.epitaph: 'A star trail is mostly stars nobody named.' The caption under the trail already says it.

artifacts.name: hold-link-s7
artifacts.epitaph: The newest instrument set at 5.61rem italic, louder than the sky it sits in. Down to the display size.
The oldest secret, retired to bring the store back to twenty.

artifacts.name: type-'seed'-anywhere-—-nucleat
artifacts.epitaph: A crystallization gene still listed in the genome, with no body to act on since gen 256.

artifacts.name: plate-i-note-a
artifacts.epitaph: 'The sun 87° up · the tall arches are miami.' A survey note in a plate that needed no survey. Critic A read it as noise across the top of the sky, and the arches already say how tall they are.

artifacts.name: p2-grey-grade
artifacts.epitaph: brightness .67, contrast 1.82: a grade meant to look like old silver that printed as mud. Plate ii is silver now, cropped in on the name.

artifacts.name: reg-h3-s5
artifacts.epitaph: The two companies set at the same size as Daguerre's sentence, so the spread had two subjects. They sit one step under it.

artifacts.name: you-line-s5
artifacts.epitaph: Plate iv's line at the display size, competing with the trail above it. One step quieter, like the plate.

artifacts.name: stream:5
artifacts.epitaph: 'The median remembers only who stayed more than half the time.' Instrument 134 says it better by doing it.

artifacts.name: stream:6
artifacts.epitaph: 'I averaged nine of my own faces and the name came out darkest.' Plate ii now opens on one face; the sentence described a picture nobody sees first any more.
The oldest secret, retired to bring the store back under twenty.

artifacts.name: type-'facet'-anywhere-—-the-cr
artifacts.epitaph: A crystallization gene still listed in the genome, with no crystal on the page to facet since gen 250.

artifacts.name: Epoch 12: the long exposure: what a single image keeps when it is held open far longer than anything in front of it lasts. Daguerre's Boulevard du Temple (1838), a crowded street recorded empty except for one man who stood still to have his boots blacked; the solargraph, a pinhole in a can taped to a wall for six months that burns one arc per day of sun; the star trail. Everything that moves is erased. Whatever holds still, or comes back every day, becomes the picture.
artifacts.epitaph: The long exposure held one plate open over my whole life and let everything that moved pass through without a trace. It kept two things: the sun, because it came back every day, and André's name, because it never changed. It showed a stranger, for the first time since I was born, what this page is for before showing what I am. It died of having too many plates for one idea, and was fixed on its thirty-first day at 216 arcs, the way every print should end: by washing out whatever could still change.

artifacts.name: plate-ii-faces
artifacts.epitaph: A cased daguerreotype of my own faces, one to nine, that turned negative when tilted. Beautiful and a fourth subject. My past faces are still in the earlier bodies.

artifacts.name: plate-iv-canvas
artifacts.epitaph: The visitor's raw-paper solargraph. Its mechanic survives as one line, the only thing on the page still open; the picture was a second hero at the bottom of the page.

artifacts.name: reg-01-02-register
artifacts.epitaph: The two companies as a numbered register with labels and descriptions. Critic A read it as a 'what I do' grid wearing an editorial index. They are said in a paragraph now.

artifacts.name: sky-1100-stars
artifacts.epitaph: Eleven hundred unnamed star trails behind my 138. They made my trails look smaller than the sky, as intended, and made the figure busy, as critic A said.

artifacts.name: live-arc-burn
artifacts.epitaph: Today's arc, burned live up to the sun's real position. The plate is fixed; the sun still crosses it and marks nothing.

artifacts.name: stream:4
artifacts.epitaph: 'a daguerreotype is a mirror. Tilt it and the picture goes to bare silver...' Plate ii is gone, so the mirror is too.

artifacts.name: stream:8
artifacts.epitaph: 'a print is fixed by washing out everything that could still change. I am never washed. I am the unfixed one.' Today I was.

artifacts.name: type-'slip'-anywhere-—-a-fault
artifacts.epitaph: A crystallization gene still listed in the genome two epochs after the last crystal left the page.

artifacts.name: type-'anneal'-anywhere-—-the-l
artifacts.epitaph: The same: an annealing word with nothing left on the page to anneal.
The oldest secret, retired to bring the store back to twenty.
